ca_cert.description: File that contains the CA certificate that signed the etcd servers' certificates. Can alternatively be set with the ETCDCTL_CACERT environment variable. Can also be omitted.

cert.description: File that contains the client certificate used to authentify the user. Can alternatively be set with the ETCDCTL_CERT environment variable. Can be omitted if password authentication is used.

connection_timeout.description: Timeout to establish the etcd servers connection as a duration. Defaults to 10s.

endpoints.description: Endpoints of the etcd servers. The entry of each server should follow the ip:port format and be coma separated. Can alternatively be set with the ETCDCTL_ENDPOINTS environment variable.

key.description: File that contains the client encryption key used to authentify the user. Can alternatively be set with the ETCDCTL_KEY environment variable. Can be omitted if password authentication is used.

password.description: Password of the etcd user that will be used to access etcd. Can alternatively be set with the ETCDCTL_PASSWORD environment variable. Can also be omitted if tls certificate authentication will be used instead.

request_timeout.description: Timeout for individual requests the provider makes on the etcd servers as a duration. Defaults to 10s.

retries.description: Number of times operations that result in retriable errors should be re-attempted. Defaults to 10.

retry_interval.description: Duration to wait after a failing etcd request before retrying. Defaults to 100ms.

skip_tls.description: If set to true, connection to the etcd cluster will be attempted in plaintext without encryption. Default to false

username.description: Name of the etcd user that will be used to access etcd. Can alternatively be set with the ETCDCTL_USERNAME environment variable. Can also be omitted if tls certificate authentication will be used instead as the username will be infered from the certificate.

enabled.description: Enable or disable auth on etcd.

block.description: Controls the authentication status (enabled or disabled) of the etcd cluster.

clear_on_deletion.description: Whether to clear the key in etcd when the resource is deleted. Useful to set to false if you wish to migrate the ownership of the key outside of a terraform project without causing disruption in the key's existence.

value.description: Value to store in the key.

clear_on_deletion.description: Whether to clear all existing keys with the prefix when the resource is deleted.

block.description: Keys to define in the prefix.
Resource to manage all the keys contained within a specified prefix.

clear_on_creation.description: Whether to clear all pre-existing keys in the range when the resource is created.

clear_on_deletion.description: Whether to clear all existing keys in the range when the resource is deleted.

key.description: Key specifying the beginning of the key range.

range_end.description: Key specifying the end of the key range (exclusive). To you set it to the value of the key scopes the range to a single key. If you would like the range to be anything prefixed by the key, you can use the etcd_prefix_range_end data helper.

block.description: Resource to manage the lifecycle of a state scoped by a key range.

name.description: Name of the role. Changing this will delete the role and create a new one.

key.description: Key specifying the beginning of the key range.

permission.description: Permissions to grant to the role on the given key range. Can be: read, write or readwrite

range_end.description: Key specifying the end of the key range (exclusive). To you set it to the value of the key to grant permission on a single key. If you would like the range to be anything prefixed by the key, you can use the etcd_prefix_range_end data helper.

block.description: Permissions to grant to the role on various etcd key ranges.
User role for etcd to define access control.

directory.description: Directory to synchronize with the key prefix.

directory_permission.description: Permission of generated directories if the directory is the destination and missing.

files_permission.description: Permission of generated files in the case where the directory is the destination.

key_prefix.description: Key prefix to synchronize with the directory.

recurrence.description: Defines when the resource should be recreated to trigger a resync. Can be set to once, onchange or always. Note that onchange looks for change during the plan phase only so consider setting it to always if another terraform resource in your script changes the source.

source.description: Authoritative source of data during the sync (data will move from the source to the destination). Can be one of: directory, key-prefix

block.description: Synchronizes the content of an key prefix and directory. Note that etcd is has a default max object size of 1.5MiB and is most suitable for keys that are bounded to a small size like configurations. Use another solution for larger files. Also, currently, only file systems following the unix convention are supported.

destination_prefix.description: Destination key prefix to synchronize to.

recurrence.description: Defines when the resource should be recreated to trigger a resync. Can be set to once, onchange or always. Note that onchange looks for change during the plan phase only so consider setting it to always if another terraform resource in your script changes the source.

source_prefix.description: Source key prefix to synchronize from.

block.description: Synchronizes a source key prefix with a destination key prefix either once when the resources is created or whenever the resource is applied. Note that the resource assumes that the destination is not being written to during synchronization.

password.description: Password of the user. Can be omitted for a user that you wish to authenticate strictly with tls certificate authentication.

roles.description: Roles of the user, to define his access.

username.description: Name of the user. Changing this will delete the user and create a new one.

create_revision.description: Revision of the etcd keystore when the key was created

lease.description: Id of the lease that the key is attached to. Will be 0 if the key is not attached to a lease.

mod_revision.description: Revision of the etcd keystore when the key was last modified

must_exist.description: Whether to cause an error if the key is not found.

version.description: Current version of the key. Note that version is reset to 0 on deletion

key.description: Key specifying the beginning of the key range.

range_end.description: Key specifying the end of the key range (exclusive). To you set it to the value of the key scopes the range to a single key. If you would like the range to be anything prefixed by the key, you can use the etcd_prefix_range_end data helper.

results.description: List of keys that were read. Note that numerical values returned by etcd are in int64 format which might cause problems in int32 platforms.

block.description: Retrieves information about the keys contained in a given range.

key.description: Key to get a prefix of.

range_end.description: Computed range end that, combined with the key, constitutes a prefix of the key.

block.description: Helper to retrieve a range end that, combined with the key argument, constitutes a prefix of key.
